validation.selection: fixed final environment IDs, excluded from gradient updates
validation.scope: held-out teacher trajectories; shared adaptive reset sampler

loss.action: KL(student || teacher), mean over samples and action dimensions
loss.feature: raw feature MSE, mean over samples and feature dimensions

previous_action_baseline.units: raw policy action, whole proprio frame clipped to [-100, 100]
previous_action_baseline.source: previous teacher action during rollout; student action during autonomous play

episode_metric_timing: pre_action_metrics; existing command metrics may precede reference advancement
student_network:
CR1PureVisualDaggerStudent(
  (depth_encoder): CR1PaperDepthEncoder(
    (network): Sequential(
      (0): Conv2d(2, 8, kernel_size=(5, 5), stride=(2, 2))
      (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (2): Conv2d(8, 8, kernel_size=(5, 5), stride=(2, 2))
      (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (4): Conv2d(8, 8, kernel_size=(5, 5), stride=(2, 2))
      (5): ELU(alpha=1.0)
      (6): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
  )
  (feature_mlp): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=989, out_features=2048, bias=True)
    (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (2): Linear(in_features=2048, out_features=1024, bias=True)
    (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (4): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=512, bias=True)
    (5): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (6): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (7): ELU(alpha=1.0)
  )
  (action_head): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=25, bias=True)
)
teacher_network:
Sequential(
  (0): Linear(in_features=780, out_features=512, bias=True)
  (1): ELU(alpha=1.0)
  (2): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
  (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
  (4): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
  (5): ELU(alpha=1.0)
  (6): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=25, bias=True)
)
observation_timing: Pre-action, including teacher labels and frame; env.step auto-resets.
metric_timing: Existing command metrics sampled pre-action; command metrics can lag reference cursor.
validation_scope: Held-out env trajectories of the same motion, sharing the adaptive sampler; not unseen-motion generalization.
iteration_convention: Zero-based optimizer-update index; rollout metrics/predictions are PRE-update, model_i is POST-update.
episode_length_convention: Observed steps tracked separately from randomized initial environment timeout counter.
